g.text: - What kind of chat app shall we design? 1 on 1 or group based?
- Is this a Mobile App or webApp or Both?
- what is the scale of this app? --> Back of the envelop estimation
- for a group chat what is the group number limit?
- what is the message size limit..?
- Is End to End Encryption required?
- How long shall we store the chat history..?

Find the right reciver for each message and send message to the right
hold the messages for the reciver if offline
- HTTP for sending messages as it is intiated bu client
- client periodically call ask the server if there are any messages avalible
- client hold the connection until there is an message or a timeout threshold has been reached
- once it recives the reuqest it will start send the request once again
- Load balancing server Instance has message may not be connected to client
- No godd way to tell if the client is disconnected
- if user doesn't chat much it is in efficient
